component.name: ALBIS
component.summary: Local-first diffraction image viewer for DECTRIS detectors

description.p: ALBIS is an ALBULA-style, browser-based desktop viewer for large HDF5 stacks and common DECTRIS detector image formats.
It supports local files, live detector streams, ROI tools, overlays, and workstation-focused review workflows for beamline and lab use.

screenshot.caption: ALBIS viewing a detector frame with analysis controls.
